# H&R Block Canada

> H&R Block Canada is a trusted Canadian tax expert with over 60 years of experience offering comprehensive tax filing services, software, and education for individuals and businesses.

H&R Block Canada provides multiple pathways for tax preparation including expert-assisted filing, online tax software, and premium services with audit support. The platform serves Canadian taxpayers at all income levels with tools, education, and professional guidance.

## Key Topics

- Tax filing services
- Canadian tax software
- Maximum refund guarantee
- H&R Block Advantage
- Free Second Look
- Tax deductions and credits
- RRSP and investment income
- CRA and tax compliance
- T4 and T5 tax slips
- Cross-border US taxes
- Tax education and certification
- Office and remote filing
- Tax calculator
- Provincial tax brackets
- Moving expenses

## Tax Filing Services

- [Income Tax Returns | Tax Filing Services](https://www.hrblock.ca/file-with-a-tax-expert): H&R Block expert tax filing services with maximum refund guarantee
- [H&R Block Advantage](https://www.hrblock.ca/experience): H&R Block Advantage premium service with audit assistance and year-round support
- [Free Second Look](https://www.hrblock.ca/second-look): H&R Block Free Second Look service reviewing past tax returns for missed deductions
- [File U.S. Taxes](https://www.hrblock.ca/tax-situations/us-tax-returns): H&R Block cross-border tax filing for US and Canadian tax returns
